episode.title: MTG Fast Finance Ep 501: Avatar Previews Wrap Up
episode.description:
The guys cover off all the latest in Magic the Gathering price movement, meta analysis, cards to watch and a final review of the Avatar preview cards. 

Intro/Outro Music by Skylarka
